Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 Must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following BodyLength field up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum (10) field. Must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Defaults to N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender. Assigned by BATS for messages sent to BATS. (TargetCompID (56) for messages from BATS.)

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination. BATS for messages sent to BXE (BATS) ports. CHIX for messages sent to CXE (Chi-X) ports. (SenderCompID (49) for messages from BATS.)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination. TEST for messages sent to the BATS test system. PROD for messages sent to the BATS production system. (SenderSubID (50) for messages from BATS.)

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Possible resend flag. BATS has special handling for the PossResend for New Order Single messages. See New Order — Single below.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on messages to BATS. Must be identifier known to BATS. May be used by non-service bureau to specify which clearing arrangement to use if multiple are configured.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. Four characters, alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and returned in DeliverToSubID (129). Available via Drop.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with PossDupFlag (43) = Y, indicates time that message was first sent. If enabled at the port or firm level, timestamps will be sent with microsecond resolution.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on message from BATS. Must be BATS approved identifier.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Returns OnBehalfOfSubID (116) optionally sent by client.

Field.Description: Must be 1 (Two-Party Report)

Field.Description: Specifies the type of trade. At this time, only the following values are valid: 0 = Regular Trade (aka Plain-Vanilla Trade) 30 = Special price (aka Trade with Conditions)

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Must be F = Trade

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN).

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by BATS: 2 = SEDOL 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: SEDOL, ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required when IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN).

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares traded on this fill (zero for non-fills).

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill (zero for non-fills).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Optional. Specifies the time at which the trade was arranged. All ‘on- exchange’ trades are deemed to take place at the time the BATS system processes them.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Optional. Specifies the date on which the trade was arranged. If present, must be the current date. See also TransactTime (60).

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Optional. Single value only (with no trailing space). The only valid value is: M = Midpoint (peg to midpoint of local book only) If set the LastPx is optional and is ignored.

Field.Name: PreviouslyReported
Field.Description: Indicates this trade was previously reported. N or missing means it was not previously reported and should be printed on the market data feed. Y means it was previously reported and should not be printed.
